new.name: Crew pay and the cut
new.what: What each man is paid for a shift or a job, from which pot, and what short or late pay does to him.
new.design: A driver gets a weekly wage from the fare book (DESIGN 9); a man on a night job gets a cut agreed in a line of talk before it, paid from the tin. Going alone keeps the whole take but brings no second man. Paid short or late, his loyalty falls and he asks for it first, the sign before breaking (DESIGN 12); paid fairly, he holds longer. No split screen: every payment is a person and a flow in the flows ledger.
new.test: S: a seeded night job paid short lowers that man's loyalty and he asks for his cut before any break; every pound paid out balances in the flows ledger.
